title: dryopteris fibrillosa
intro: Dryopteris fibrillosa, commonly known as the Scaly Male Fern, is a species of fern native to the mountainous regions of Asia and the Himalayas. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including being used to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris fibrillosa include acting as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent, helping to soothe and calm various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
